Analysis.description: One optional result. Historical absence cannot imply successful execution.

capability.description: Whether this producer established the requested evidence.

evidence.description: Measurements, never an independent approval authority.

provenance.description: Reproduction information; absent for historical, unrecorded evidence.

Analysis2.description: One optional result. Historical absence cannot imply successful execution.

capability.description: Whether this producer established the requested evidence.

evidence.description: Measurements, never an independent approval authority.

provenance.description: Reproduction information; absent for historical, unrecorded evidence.

Attribution.description: Algebraic component decomposition, with no causal or physical-model inference.

components.description: Supplied additive components, ordered by name.

residual.description: Final minus summed components, computed per pixel before averaging.

Attribution2.description: Attribution from one capture-side object/material ID pair.

image_path.description: Copied ID image path, relative to the report directory.

image_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the native PNG or EXR ID image.

legend_path.description: Copied legend path, relative to the report directory.

Background.description: Optional background definition for gap/coverage statistics.

oneOf.description: Luminance at or below a normalized sRGB threshold.
All RGB channels within a normalized distance from a colour.
Supplied mask or side-specific native layer selection marks background.

BufferKind.description: Meaning of the samples in a non-colour image.

oneOf.description: Normalised depth, or linear floating-point depth.
Unit surface normals.
Two-dimensional motion vectors.
Exact discrete mask samples.
Exact discrete identifier samples.

heatmap_max.description: Per-image p99 error, floored by the threshold and 1e-12, at the top of the colormap.

scale.description: Motion-vector scale, in pixels per signed component unit.

BufferStats.description: Statistics in the buffer's units, rather than perceptual FLIP units.

changed_pixels.description: Mask/id only: number of changed pixels.

exact_match_fraction.description: Mask/id only: fraction of pixels with identical native samples, including alpha.

mean.description: Mean absolute depth, angular or end-point error; changed fraction for discrete buffers.

Capability.description: Availability is separate from a measurement or verdict.

oneOf.description: The requested computation was performed within its declared scope.
Evidence was not supplied or cannot establish applicability.
This implementation cannot perform the requested computation.
The caller explicitly excluded the computation.
Inputs or execution failed validation.

CaptureValidity.description: Validity and the missing context or violated requirements explaining it.

ChangeClass.description: What kind of change separates the capture from the baseline.

oneOf.description: High-frequency texture differences without significant spatial bias.
Spatially clustered signed bias, coverage or detail loss; regions in spatial evidence.
Decoded pixels are exactly equal.
FLIP is zero, while native decoded samples differ.

A difference whose peak FLIP is at or below `noise_max_flip` and that
no tone shift or offset explains.

One global tone fit (exposure, tint, black level) removes at least
`explained_min` of the error.

Neither a tone fit nor an offset removes `partial_min` of the error and
the error is above noise level.

A tone fit or an offset explains part (at least `partial_min`, below
`explained_min`) of the error; the rest is something else.

A detected sub-pixel or whole-pixel offset removes at least
`explained_min` of the error.

The capture is unusable: all black or all white (the baseline is not),
a flat colour, or it holds NaN or infinite samples.

ComponentDelta.description: One additive component's observed difference in linear RGB.

projected_share.description: Projection onto final delta / final squared norm; signed and may exceed one.

Diagnostics.description: What the diagnostics engine found for one compared pair.

description.description:
A deterministic, template-based sentence; every cause it names is
backed by the numbers below.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall time of the whole analysis in milliseconds.

motion.description: Conditional per-hotspot motion evidence; raw unaligned FLIP remains authoritative.

nonfinite.description: Non-finite samples of the capture; `None` when there are none.

perf.description: Timing keys present on both sides' sidecars, largest relative change first.

perf_not_comparable.description: Keys matching the timing globs that are present on only one side.

residual.description: Error left after the tone fit; present exactly when `tone` is.

shift.description: Sub-pixel shift; `None` when disabled, identical or negligible.

signed.description: Luminance direction; `None` for an identical pair.

tone.description: Global tone fit; `None` for an identical pair or a negligible error.

EffectResult.description: Required effect evidence and its exact policy.

Energy.description: Per-tile temporal metrics for one side.

delta_variance.description: Mean over pixels of variance of frame-to-frame luminance differences.

high_frequency_energy.description: Mean squared second temporal difference divided by four.

baseline_properties.description: Structural checks on the baseline; `None` when there is no decodable baseline.

baseline_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the baseline file as compared.

bit_identical.description: Whether the decoded pixels are exactly equal; `None` unless compared.

buffer.description: Numerical comparison for non-colour buffers; FLIP metrics stay absent.

capture_provenance.description: Binary, source and capture identities from capture metadata or cost cards.

capture_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the capture file as compared.

capture_validity.description: Capture validity, independent of sample equality and perceptual error.

changed_pixel_runs.description:
Every unmasked pixel above the hotspot threshold, as row-major runs.
Unlike `hotspots`, this detection mask has no display cap or share filter.

covered_by_derivation.description: Differences covered by explicit fingerprint-map derivations, with both values.

diagnostics.description:
Why the images differ: cause decomposition, sub-pixel shift, signed
difference, non-finite map, timing pairs and a plain-English
description (see [`crate::diagnostics`]). `None` when diagnostics are
disabled or the pair was not compared as images.

error.description: Human-readable reason; `Some` exactly when status is error.

file_bytes_identical.description: File-byte equality, separate from decoded-sample equality.

gallery.description: Automatic crop gallery and per-region statistics.

hdr.description: HDR-FLIP settings when the pair was compared as HDR.

hotspots.description:
Where the FLIP error is concentrated, largest first (see
[`crate::hotspots`]); empty when none exceed the threshold, when the
pair was not compared or when hotspots are disabled.

intended_variables.description: Intended metadata variables with before/after values, including unchanged keys.

layers.description: Source-bound layer selection and additive component decomposition.

masked_fraction.description: Fraction of pixels excluded by masks; `None` when no mask applied.

meta_declared_unchanged.description: Declared keys present on both sides whose values did not change.

meta_diff.description: Sidecar keys that differ between the sides (ignored keys excluded).

meta_ignored_diff.description:
Sidecar keys that differ but were ignored (timestamps, durations...),
listed so an ignore glob that hides a real change stays visible.

metric_used.description: Metric that decided `status` for this entry (after overrides).

metrics.description: Full FLIP statistics; `None` unless status is pass or fail.

name.description: Path relative to the baseline/capture roots, `/`-separated.

object_attribution.description: Per-hotspot error attributed to object/material IDs supplied with the capture.

pass_with_local_change.description: Additive status: the deciding metric passes but a severe local change exists.

paths.description: Image paths relative to the report directory.

pixel_exclusions.description: Full-map error on excluded pixels, independent of the configured verdict.

properties.description: Structural checks on the capture; `None` when there is no decodable capture.

regions.description: Per-region results (config `[[region]]`); a failing region fails the entry.

required_effects.description: Opt-in effect occupancy and region measurements (wave9).

sample_exclusions.description: Decoder channel and precision losses; historical absence means unknown.

spatial.description: Opt-in multiscale and tile structural evidence.

threshold.description: Threshold that decided `status` for this entry (after overrides).

value.description: Value of `metric_used`; `None` unless status is pass or fail.

warnings.description:
Non-fatal observations: an all-black or all-white image, non-finite
samples, a local hotspot that failed an otherwise passing entry.

EntryAudit.description: Exclusions and unknowns for one entry, including passing entries.

configured_status.description: Original configured verdict; the audit cannot change it.

ignored_metadata.description: Metadata changes explicitly ignored by policy.

informational_regions.description: Region names without a deciding threshold.

limitations.description: Channel, HDR and other unmeasured scope statements.

thresholds.description: All deciding thresholds and their remaining margin.

validity.description: Capture validity, including missing keys and source provenance.

EntryPaths.description:
Paths (relative to the report directory, `/`-separated) of the images the
report copies or generates. `None` when that image does not exist.

nonfinite_mask.description:
Mask of NaN (magenta), infinite (yellow) and negative (cyan) samples of
an HDR capture, when it has any.

signed_diff.description:
Signed luminance difference (blue darker, orange brighter), when
diagnostics ran on a non-identical pair.

ExclusionAudit.description: Run scope beyond the per-pixel masks stored on each entry.

entries.description: Per-entry bounds and gaps in report order.

excluded_captures.description: Observed names removed by ignore globs or entry selection.

incomplete_captures.description: Selected names without a complete measurable pair.

performance.description: Performance qualification; absent performance stays unknown.

Failure.description: Typed non-vacuity failure retained even when FLIP is zero.

oneOf.description: Effect occupancy is below the declared minimum.

required.description: Required count after resolving the fractional minimum.

GalleryRegion.description: Automatic gallery region with its artifact links and local statistics.

gap_change.description: Mean tile gap change in this footprint.

reasons.description: Selection reason(s): hotspot, bias, coverage, or detail.

signed_shift.description: Signed mean normalized sRGB luminance shift.

zoom_2x.description: Exact 2x nearest-neighbour enlargement of the strip.

HdrInfo.description: HDR comparison settings actually used for an entry (HDR-FLIP).

auto_range.description: Whether the exposure range was computed from the baseline (true) or given.

tonemapper.description: Tone mapper applied at each exposure (`"aces"`, `"hable"`, `"reinhard"`).

Hotspot.description:
One concentration of FLIP error on the frame, in pixels of the compared
images. Masked pixels never count.

area_frac.description: `area_px` as a fraction of the frame.

area_px.description: Number of pixels above the hotspot threshold that make up the hotspot.

mean_flip.description: Mean FLIP error over the unmasked pixels inside `rect_px`.

pixel_runs.description:
Exact row-major runs of pixels in this component: [start, length].
Empty only for reports produced before exact-mask support.

position.description:
Coarse 3x3 position of the box centre: `top-left`, `top-center`,
`top-right`, `middle-left`, `center`, `middle-right`, `bottom-left`,
`bottom-center`, `bottom-right`.

rect_frac.description: The same box as fractions of the frame, `[x, y, w, h]`.

rect_px.description: Bounding box `[x, y, w, h]` in pixels.

share_of_total_error.description:
Summed error of the hotspot's pixels over the summed error of every
unmasked pixel of the frame, in `[0, 1]`.

HotspotAttribution.description: Attribution for one numbered hotspot's bounding box.

hotspot.description: One-based index into the entry's `hotspots` list.

measured_hot_pixels.description: Hot pixels measured inside the box; may differ from hotspot component area.

IdContribution.description: A single ID's share of FLIP error above the hotspot cutoff inside a box.

error_share.description: FLIP error sum for this ID divided by all hot error inside the box.

id.description: Numeric ID encoded in the sidecar image.

name.description: Name from the sidecar legend, or `<unlabeled>` for ID zero.

pixels.description: Number of above-cutoff pixels assigned to this ID.

LayerResult.description: Layer evidence added to the comparison entry.

attribution.description: Decomposition if requested and components present.

included_pixels.description: Included pixel count; empty scopes fail.

LayerScope.description: Layer-based inclusion, applied to every deciding statistic.

MetaDiff.description: One metadata key whose value differs between the two sides.

baseline.description: Value on the baseline side, or `<absent>`.

capture.description: Value on the capture side, or `<absent>`.

Metric.description: Which statistic of the FLIP error map decides pass/fail.

oneOf.description: Mean FLIP error over all pixels.
95th-percentile FLIP error.
99th-percentile FLIP error.
Maximum FLIP error.

Metrics.description:
FLIP error-map statistics. All error values are in `[0, 1]`; a non-finite
value (which a valid run does not produce) is serialized as `null` and read
back as NaN.

Motion.description: Consecutive-frame global translation estimate; unavailable motion is explicit.

MotionClass.description: Per-hotspot interpretation under the recorded global translation hypothesis.

oneOf.description: Displacement and aligned residual are below the declared diagnostic limits.
Qualified global displacement explains this hotspot's appearance residual.
Significant appearance residual without appreciable global displacement.
Appreciable global displacement and significant remaining appearance residual.
Correspondence, texture or valid coverage is insufficient.

aligned_valid_flip_mean.description: Aligned FLIP mean only on valid interior pixels.

border_margin_px.description: Conservative interpolation plus FLIP filter border margin.

dense_flow.description: Dense independent-object correspondence is unsupported in this build.

forward_backward_error.description: Length of forward + reverse displacement, in pixels.

invalid_border_runs.description: Pixels excluded from aligned evidence, as row-major [start,length] runs.

peak_ratio.description: Best correlation peak divided by the strongest peak outside a 3-pixel neighbourhood.

phase_coherence.description: Weighted phase coherence; not a probability.

raw_full_frame_flip_mean.description: Original complete-frame FLIP mean; never replaced with aligned measurements.

translation.description: Capture displacement against baseline, right/down positive, in pixels.

MotionHotspot.description: One original hotspot measured without changing its selected pixel mask.

aligned_flip_max.description: Peak aligned FLIP on the same valid pixels; prevents small defects being diluted in a large hotspot.

aligned_flip_mean.description: Aligned FLIP mean on those same valid pixels.

class.description: Conditional diagnostic class, not an acceptance decision.

explained_fraction.description: Fraction of raw mean removed by alignment, clamped to [0,1].

hotspot.description: Index in the original ordered hotspot list.

raw_flip_mean.description: Original FLIP mean on those same valid pixels.

reasons.description: Why correspondence or classification remains unresolved.

texture_std.description: Baseline encoded-luminance standard deviation on the valid pixels.

valid_fraction.description: Fraction of original hotspot pixels retained.

valid_pixels.description: Number of original hotspot pixels retained after border exclusion.

NonFiniteCluster.description: A connected group of non-finite samples.

rect_px.description: Bounding box `[x, y, w, h]` in pixels.

NonFiniteMap.description: Where the capture holds NaN, infinite or negative samples (HDR only).

cluster_count.description: Number of 8-connected groups of affected pixels.

clusters.description: Boxes of the first [`MAX_NONFINITE_CLUSTERS`] groups in raster order.

PerfDelta.description: One timing key present on both sides.

delta_pct.description: `delta` as a percentage of `baseline`; `None` when `baseline` is 0.

PerfNotComparable.description: A timing key present on only one side, which cannot establish a timing change.

key.description: Exact sidecar key; differently named timings are never paired.

PerfSide.description: Side on which an unpaired timing key was recorded.

oneOf.description: The baseline sidecar.
The capture sidecar.

PixelExclusions.description: Full-map evidence retained before masks are applied to the verdict.

error_max.description: Maximum FLIP on excluded pixels; absent for an empty mask.

error_mean.description: Mean FLIP on excluded pixels; absent for an empty mask.

error_sum.description: Summed FLIP error on excluded pixels.

full_frame_value.description: Entry metric on the complete unmasked error map.

mask_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the resolved row-major mask (one 0/1 byte per pixel).

runs.description: Excluded pixels as row-major [start, length] runs.

without_masks.description: Diagnostic verdict with all masks removed, same regions and thresholds.

fixed_camera.description: Required declaration, independently checked for global translation.

fps.description: Frame rate for interpretation; no resampling.

increase_ratio.description: Minimum ratio above the baseline temporal variance/energy floor.

motion_confidence.description: Minimum phase-coherence confidence for a motion finding.

motion_max_px.description: Maximum detected global displacement in pixels.

variance_increase.description: Minimum increase in temporal delta variance.

Policy2.description: Layer policy for ordinary colour comparison or a BufferSpec.

attribution.description: Decompose additive RGB layers into final-image delta plus residual.

manifest.description: Optional sidecar filename in each image parent; otherwise <filename>.layers.json.

Policy3.description: Versioned, recorded numerical policy; opt-in to normal compare.

ci_z.description: Normal-approximation CI multiplier over paired pixel residuals.

coarse_flip_ratio_max.description: Full-resolution/coarse FLIP attenuation threshold for texture noise.

coarse_mad_max.description: Coarse normalized mean absolute RGB tolerance (half an 8-bit code).

decide.description: If true, use the structural verdict for acceptance; historical metric remains recorded.

detail_ratio_tolerance.description: Maximum relative change in absolute Laplacian detail energy.

gallery_top.description: Maximum gallery regions; zero disables generated crops.

gap_shift.description: Minimum absolute gap-fraction change to mark a tile.

luminance_floor.description: Minimum luminance denominator for relative shifts and contrast.

min_cluster_tiles.description: Minimum connected significant tiles for a clustered bias finding.

scales.description: Integer area-reduction factors; full resolution is always reported.

shifted_share_max.description: Fraction of relative-shifted tiles above which bias cannot be called benign.

sparse_tiles.description: Sparse absolute outlier tiles tolerated by small coarse-error evidence.

ssimulacra2.description: Optional pinned SSIMULACRA2 at meaningful (>=8x8 opaque) scales.

tile_size.description: Regular tile width and height in capture pixels; edge tiles are retained.

Predicate.description: Selection rule evaluated in native units (ID PNGs retain integer values).

oneOf.description: Exact native integer labels.
Inclusive range in scalar/depth units.
Scalar greater than the declared threshold.
Nonzero scalar mask samples.

Properties.description: Structural sanity checks on a single image (catches black frames, blowouts).

inf_count.description: Samples that are infinite (HDR images only).

nan_count.description: Samples that are NaN (HDR images only; always 0 for 8-bit images).

negative_count.description: Finite samples below zero (HDR images only).

Provenance.description: Reproduction details shared by optional analysis features.

implementation.description: Algorithm name and revision, independently of the tool version.

resources.description: Exact resources, in producer-declared stable order.

settings.description: Explicit preprocessing, execution and sampling settings.

tiles.description: Contributing tile indexes in row-major order.

RegionResult.description: Result of one named region of interest of an entry.

metrics.description: FLIP statistics over the region; `width`/`height` are the region's.

rect_px.description: Rectangle in pixels after resolving the config fractions: `[x, y, w, h]`.

status.description: `Pass`/`Fail` when the region has a threshold; `None` when informational.

threshold.description: Threshold, when the region has one.

value.description:
Value of `metric_used` over the region (masked pixels excluded); a
fully masked region has no pixels and is `null` (read back as NaN).

Report.description: Sequence verdict and motion flags, independent of still-image FLIP thresholds.

regions.description: Bounding boxes of connected shimmering tiles.

RequiredEffect.description: Opt-in occupancy gate for a named effect.

min_fraction.description: Minimum fraction of the full image. Both minima must hold.

min_pixels.description: Minimum occupied pixels. Defaults to one to forbid vacuous proofs.

sides.description: Side(s) on which to enforce occupancy.

Residual.description: FLIP error that remains once the global tone shift is removed.

flip_max.description: Maximum FLIP error of the tone-corrected capture.

flip_mean.description:
Mean FLIP error of the tone-corrected capture (the original mean when
the tone fit is negligible).

hotspots.description: Where that error is concentrated, largest first (at most 3).

Resource.description: Content-bound resource; absent hashes or licences remain explicit unknowns.

license.description: SPDX expression or a referenced custom licence; never inferred from code.

name.description: Logical resource name, not a machine-specific path.

role.description: Role such as input, implementation, weights or configuration.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of exact resource bytes, when available.

Scale.description: Independent perceptual statistics and floating area RGB difference at a scale.

divisor.description: Area reduction divisor; 1 is the original.

mad_rgb.description: Floating area mean absolute normalized RGB difference.

ScopeMode.description: Side(s) used to define a comparison scope.

oneOf.description: Union retains both disappearing and newly appearing occupancy.
Both selections must match.
Freeze the reference footprint.
Candidate footprint only, explicitly declared.

Selection.description: Generic inclusion source, never an exclusion mask.

oneOf.description: Source-bound named layer from the image-adjacent manifest.

manifest.description: Optional plain manifest filename; defaults to <filename>.layers.json.

oneOf.description: White/nonzero image pixels; exact dimensions required.
Pixel boxes with exclusive far edges.
Native side-specific layer.

image.description: Layer file relative to each image's parent.

SequenceFrame.description: One sorted-index pair, including its actual source names and numbers.

entry.description: Normal comparison entry; images are keyed by its safe synthetic name.

index.description: Zero-based sorted index, independent of either sequence's numbering origin.

ShiftEstimate.description: Sub-pixel shift of the capture against the baseline.

coarse_downsample.description: Factor the first estimate's luminance plane was downsampled by.

confidence.description:
Weighted phase coherence of the cross-spectrum around the fitted
shift, in `[0, 1]`: 1 for a pure translation, near 0 for unrelated
content.

dx.description: Horizontal offset of the capture's content in pixels; positive is right.

dy.description: Vertical offset in pixels; positive is down.

estimate_ms.description: Wall time of the estimate (excluding the compensated FLIP run), in ms.

shift_explained_fraction.description:
Share of the mean FLIP error removed by resampling the capture back by
`(dx, dy)`; `None` unless `detected`.

Sides.description: Which side must contain the required effect.

oneOf.description: Both captures (default).
Baseline only.
Candidate only.

SignedDiff.description: Which way the luminance moved, over the whole frame.

frac_brighter.description: Fraction of finite pixel pairs brighter by more than half a code value.

frac_darker.description: Fraction of finite pixel pairs darker by more than half a code value.

mean_delta.description:
Mean of `capture - baseline` over finite pixel pairs only. Luminance is
encoded Rec. 709 for LDR; for HDR, scene-linear Rec. 709 luminance is
clamped to `[0, 1]` on each side to bound the display scale. Positive is
brighter. Zero when there are no finite pairs.

scale.description:
Luminance difference mapped to full colour in `signed_diff.png` (the
99.5th percentile of finite absolute differences, at least 0.004).

SpatialReport.description: Structural evidence; the original FLIP value remains available independently.

silhouette_disagreement.description: Gap-mask XOR / union, if a background predicate was declared.

Stats.description: Statistics from the full-frame error map within a selected footprint.

max_flip.description: Maximum FLIP; absent for an empty footprint.

mean_flip.description: Mean FLIP; absent for an empty footprint.

oneOf.description: `value <= threshold`.
`value > threshold`.
Capture present, baseline absent.
Baseline present, capture absent.
Could not be compared; see [`Entry::error`].

Threshold.description: A configured bound and its measured remaining margin.

headroom.description: Limit minus measured value; a negative value exceeds the bound.

value.description: Measured value; absent when not measured.

pixels.description: Included pixels measured in the persistent scope.

shimmer_increase.description: Increase exceeds absolute and relative thresholds.

Tile2.description: One tile, including signed effects that max FLIP obscures.

absolute_shifted.description: CI excludes zero and absolute threshold exceeded.

baseline_gap.description: Baseline share satisfying the declared background criterion.

coarse_mean_flip.description: Coarsest-scale mean FLIP for the tile footprint.

relative_shifted.description: CI excludes zero and relative threshold exceeded.

shift_ci.description: Normal approximation CI over paired pixel shifts.

variance_ratio.description: Candidate variance / baseline variance, null if baseline zero and candidate nonzero.

ToneShift.description: Global tone fit of the capture against the baseline, in linear light.

bias.description: The per-channel bias, in linear light (0 when the fit was gain-only).

exposure_stops.description:
Exposure change in stops: `log2` of the luminance-weighted gain.
Negative is darker.

gain.description: `capture = gain * baseline + bias`, per channel `[r, g, b]`.

model.description:
`affine` when gain and bias were fitted, `gain` when the baseline had
too little tonal range for a bias.

summary.description:
One human-readable line, for example `3.1% darker (-0.05 stops), +0.02
red offset`.

tone_explained_fraction.description:
Share of the mean FLIP error removed by applying the inverse fit to the
capture, in `[0, 1]`; 0 when the fit is negligible.

white_balance.description:
Tint relative to green, for example `warmer (red +2.1%, blue -1.8% vs
green)`, or `neutral`.

error.description: Could not be compared (decode failure, dimension mismatch).

fail.description: Entries whose metric exceeds their threshold.

pass.description: Entries whose metric is at or below their threshold.

Validity.description: Capture comparability, independent of native sample equality.

oneOf.description: Supplied capture requirements are satisfied.
Evidence violates a supplied requirement or cannot be decoded safely.
The supplied context cannot establish comparability.

Witness.description: Retained layer content and manifest identities used for scope/attribution.

layers.description: Named layer hashes, computed from retained bytes.

manifest_path.description: Bundled manifest path, when comparison wrote a portable report.

paths.description: Bundled exact layer bytes, keyed by layer name.

WorstFrame.description: Worst paired frame by mean FLIP.

name.description: Synthetic entry name in the per-frame report.

description: Full sequence report on disk; lean outputs omit `frames` and `mean_flip_curve`.

baseline_temporal_mean.description: Mean FLIP between consecutive baseline frames; null with fewer than two or errors.

capture_temporal_mean.description: Mean FLIP between consecutive capture frames; null with fewer than two or errors.

exclusion_audit.description: Full comparison scope, including ignored and pattern-excluded source frames.

frames.description: Per-frame details on disk; omitted from lean output.

frames_over_threshold.description: Paired entries whose deciding value exceeds their effective threshold.

frames_report_json.description: Per-frame report path relative to the working directory (absolute by opt-in).

index_html.description: HTML report path relative to the working directory (absolute by opt-in).

mean_flip_curve.description: Per-index mean FLIP, null for an unmeasured pair.

report_json.description: JSON report path relative to the working directory (absolute by opt-in).

temporal_errors.description: Reasons a temporal metric could not be measured. These fail the run.

temporal_instability.description: Capture temporal mean minus baseline temporal mean; signed, not clamped.

tile_stability.description: Fixed-camera per-tile flicker and global motion qualification.

totals.description: Status counts of the indexed pairs.

verdict.description: `pass` or `regression`, with the same rules as compare plus temporal errors.

worst_frame.description: Worst paired frame by mean FLIP, earliest index wins a tie.
